# Atilade Gabriel Oke

## Summary
Atilade Gabriel Oke builds cool stuff for people and agents. Analyst, Data & AI at ION in London. Founder of Refinery, which proves AI changes to enterprise COBOL are safe to deploy. Venture Scout, introducing exceptional founders to a venture fund. BEng Electrical & Electronic Engineering, University of Manchester (2026). 12x hackathon winner and #1 IBM Z Student Ambassador 2025-26.

## Current Focus
- Refinery (https://refinery.guru): deterministic checks, a Z3 formal proof and a signed certificate for every AI change to COBOL
- Building with teams of AI agents (Claude Code and Codex) on a shared task board
- Data and AI at ION, on high-yield bonds
